requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with amount, category, date, and description

criteria.must: An employee can create a claim by providing amount, category, date, and description
A created claim starts in submitted status
The category must be one of the fixed predefined categories

requirements.statement: An employee can attach a receipt to their expense claim

criteria.must: An employee can attach a receipt file to a claim
A claim can be submitted without a receipt attached

requirements.statement: An employee can view the status of their submitted claims

criteria.must: An employee can list their own submitted claims
Each listed claim shows whether it is pending, approved, or rejected
An employee cannot view another employee's claims

requirements.statement: An employee can see why a claim was rejected and resubmit a corrected version

criteria.must: A rejected claim displays the manager's rejection reason
An employee can resubmit a corrected version of a rejected claim
A resubmitted claim returns to submitted status

requirements.statement: A manager can see a queue of pending expense claims from their team

criteria.must: A manager can list pending claims submitted by their direct reports
A manager does not see pending claims from employees who do not report to them

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a claim so only legitimate expenses move toward payroll

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim, moving it to approved status
A manager can reject a pending claim, moving it to rejected status
A non-manager cannot approve or reject a claim

requirements.statement: A manager must give a reason when rejecting a claim

criteria.must: Rejecting a claim without a reason is refused
A rejected claim stores the reason the manager gave

requirements.statement: Finance can see all approved claims that haven't been exported yet

criteria.must: Finance can list claims that are approved and not yet exported
An already-exported claim does not appear in this list
A non-finance user cannot access this list

requirements.statement: Finance can export approved claims to a downloadable file for payroll

criteria.must: Finance can trigger an export of selected approved claims and receive a downloadable file
A claim that is not in approved status is refused for export

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked as exported so they are never sent to payroll twice

criteria.must: A claim moves to exported status once it has been exported
An exported claim cannot be exported again

requirements.statement: Every user signs in via SSO through Thunder before using the system

criteria.must: An unauthenticated request to any expense-claim action is rejected
A user signs in through the platform's SSO flow before reaching their role's screens

requirements.statement: Employees and managers receive an email notification when a claim's status changes

criteria.must: An email notification is sent to the employee when their claim is approved or rejected
